initial_storage_basis: 1793 acre-feet preparation assumption; not observed 2015 initial storage
inflow_basis: Frozen, already routed upstream daily reservoir-boundary inflow; offline hindsight data, not a forecast
routing_basis: FEWalter to Downstream uses identity UH [1.0], an interface fixture without real river travel time
release_source: Fixed offline request; no model-generated operating_mode, rules or reasoning
target_basis: No verified annual numeric target schedule is supplied; do not substitute 1370 ft
losses_and_spill_basis: Reservoir losses set to zero; excess capacity spills within the day without a gate/rating model
